verdict.rationale: Datacenter-scale interconnect and multi-GPU deployment are fair questions to ask of any GPU, so this axis applies. The evidence never documents a high-bandwidth GPU-to-GPU interconnect, multi-GPU topology, or rack-scale deployment for the RX 9070 XT. AMD instead positions it as a local workstation card. The ROCm claims of a 'seamless migration path' to Instinct accelerators in the datacenter describe a different product line, so they earn no credit here.
